questions.question: Discuss the significance of page layout in document creation. What factors should be considered when choosing page orientation and size? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the significance of page layout in document creation. What factors
  • should be considered when choosing page orientation and size?
  • Significance of Page Layout in Document Creation(2 marks)
  • ● Determines the Structure and Readability of the Document
  • Page layout controls margins, spacing, orientation, and arrangement of text and images. A good
  • layout ensures that the document is visually balanced and easy to read.
  • ● Enhances Professional Appearance
  • Well-designed layouts make reports, letters, brochures, and academic documents look organized and
  • polished. Consistent layout improves the overall quality of the document.
  • ● Ensures Proper Placement of Content
  • Page layout decides how headings, paragraphs, tables, graphics, and charts fit onto the page. It
  • prevents text from appearing cluttered and avoids improper page breaks.

questions.question: Explain the concept of kerning and tracking in typography / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the concept of kerning and tracking in typography
  • Kerning(1.5 marks)
  • ● Kerning is the adjustment of space between specific pairs of characters.
  • ● Done to avoid awkward spacing, especially in combinations like AV, WA, To.
  • ● Improves the readability and aesthetic balance of text.
  • Tracking(1.5 marks)
  • ● Tracking is the uniform adjustment of spacing across a range of characters or entire
  • words/paragraphs.
  • ● Increasing tracking spreads the text out; decreasing it brings characters closer.
  • ● Used for titles, headings, and stylistic effects.
